name: Shinigami's Blessing
flavor: You are a symbol of death, free from the laws that bind most reapers
prerequisites: Weapon Focus (Scythe), Weapon Focus (any non-Scythe), Worshiper of Pythes
benefits: When wielding a weapon you have the Weapon Focus feat for, and that weapon is not a Scythe, you may treat it as a Scythe for the purposes of Weapon Focus (Scythe).
